name: Omaconnect KDE Plus
author: Ryan Winkler; based on Jitendra Dara’s OmaConnect
description: KDE Connect device actions, file sharing, custom icons and optional Tailscale, MikroTik Back to Home and WireGuard views for Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Devices, file submission, appearance and existing home-access controls

showBatteryStats.description: Display battery percentage and charging state

showBarBattery.description: Display battery percentage next to the icon in the bar

showNetworkStats.description: Display cellular network type and signal strength

showTailscale.description: Legacy discovery setting; disabled in this fork. Use networkTailscaleEnabled to show the current Tailscale integration.

showMediaPlayer.description: Display media player controls for paired devices

showTroubleshooting.description: Legacy setting retained for migration; setup actions are disabled in this fork.

showActionRing.description: Legacy visibility preference. Use quickActionsOrder in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

showActionClipboard.description: Legacy visibility preference. Use quickActionsOrder in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

showActionFile.description: Legacy visibility preference. Use quickActionsOrder in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

showActionSms.description: Legacy visibility preference. Use quickActionsOrder in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

showActionPing.description: Legacy visibility preference. Use quickActionsOrder in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

showActionText.description: Legacy visibility preference. Use quickActionsOrder in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

bthHelperPath.description: Absolute path to the existing remote-access-mode helper. Empty uses ~/.local/bin/remote-access-mode.

networkTailscaleEnabled.description: Show Tailscale integration. This display setting does not connect or disconnect a VPN.

networkBthEnabled.description: Show MikroTik Back to Home integration. This display setting does not connect or disconnect a VPN.

networkWireguardEnabled.description: Show other WireGuard profiles integration. This display setting does not connect or disconnect a VPN.

quickActionsOrder.description: Ordered optional quick action IDs. Configure add, remove and order in Plus Settings → Quick actions.

showSavedAddresses.description: Show the saved-address review section; no automatic rediscovery is enabled

showSyncthingLinks.description: Show optional local identity notes and the existing Syncthing owner route

showNetworkControls.description: Show enabled network-provider controls in Devices

networkStartExpanded.description: Expand network-provider controls when the daily panel opens

mediaStartExpanded.description: Expand media controls when the daily panel opens

commandsStartExpanded.description: Expand remote commands when the daily panel opens

addressesStartExpanded.description: Expand saved addresses when the daily panel opens

syncthingStartExpanded.description: Expand the optional Syncthing identity note when the daily panel opens

showNativeFeatures.description: Show the native KDE feature entry in Devices; inventory remains available in Settings

navigationAtTop.description: Place daily navigation at Top; false keeps it at Bottom, with devices first.

showSendShortcut.description: Show a direct Send shortcut beside the view menu; Send remains in the menu.

showActivityShortcut.description: Show a direct Activity shortcut beside the view menu; Activity remains in the menu.

devicesStartExpanded.description: Start device details expanded. This changes the daily layout only.

showQuickActions.description: Show quick actions. This changes the daily layout only.

actionsStartExpanded.description: Start quick actions expanded. This changes the daily layout only.

showInlineSend.description: Show file sharing. This changes the daily layout only.

inlineSendStartExpanded.description: Start file sharing expanded. This changes the daily layout only.

nativeFeaturesStartExpanded.description: Start Native KDE Connect expanded. This changes the daily layout only.

sectionOrder.description: Ordered daily section IDs. Empty uses the default order. Hidden sections keep their position.
